credits.title: Mate's Rate
credits.overview: After getting fired, Uji, a graphic designer, teams up with her three closest friends to start a creative agency. Amid client demands, family expectations, and friendship dilemmas, she hopes this could be a new beginning. But deeper she goes, the more she realizes: every relationship has its price, friendship included.

credits.title: Amelia, Amelia
credits.overview: Amelia, a 12-year-old Chinese-Indonesian girl, has just learned of a tradition that says women who have received their period must not wash their underwear together with men's clothes, or the men will face bad luck.

credits.title: Hear the Ping Pong Sing
credits.overview: Caitlin, a 6-year-old girl, navigates her life amid the commotion of her family’s arguments in a Hokkien dialect she doesn’t understand. She tries to make sense of the confusing pressures and emotions around her through the rhythmic sound of a ping-pong ball.

credits.title: Ringroad
credits.overview: Mulyani, a domestic worker who decided to run away from an elite housing complex with Reza, her boyfriend, a construction worker. They are on an adventure and have to face the consequences of violating Mulyani's work contract.

credits.title: Laki-laki dan Burung-burungnya
credits.overview: While taking care of his beloved pet bird named Jambu, Attal must face his older brother who keeps on taking away his money.

credits.title: Seperti Sediakala
credits.overview: One night, Intan visits Sekala Jewelry Store to make her wedding ring. There, she meets Kala, a mysterious jeweler who seems very familiar to Intan. How will fate lead them?

credits.title: Sunny Side of the Street
credits.overview: Sunny Side of the Street follows a young truck driver who is looking for his wife amidst the riots and commotion in 1998, Jakarta.
